item.title: With less-reliable powder days, Colorado ski resorts invest in snowmaking, push preseason pass sales
item.description: When Keystone Resort became the first ski area to open in the fall, nearly all of the snow on its two open runs was artificial. It's among the adaptations increasingly adopted by Colorado's resorts.

item.title: A Colorado court sends poor people to jail without access to lawyers, advocates say. It doesn’t record the proceedings.
item.description: House Bill 26-1134, titled “Fairness and Transparency in Municipal Court,” clarifies that municipal court defendants have a right to counsel.

item.title: Colorado’s ski resorts face an existential threat — and growing call for climate action
item.description: "Climate is an issue that has been polarized. But who doesn’t want clean air, clean water and more powder days?” an Aspen Skiing Co. official said.

item.title: Colorado ski season could be several weeks shorter by 2050 as climate warms
item.description: "While I don't think that we should imminently be concerned about the existence of our ski industry ... the quality of the skiing is slowly deteriorating," CU Boulder Professor Noah Molotch says.

item.title: Colorado holds off on capping pay for home caregivers — for now
item.description: If lawmakers determine they have to cap caregivers' paid hours, they'll need to give families ample notice so they can start preparing, said Sen. Judy Amabile, a Boulder Democrat.
